data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
(None — infrastructure task; DD ownership via task-2 which satisfies dd-1.)

Mirror the pattern that story 699e established with enumerate_orphan_anomalies(). Add a module-level function enumerate_duplicate_anomalies() to plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-bridge-fsck.py that returns {"duplicates": [<duplicate_set>, ...]} where each set is a list of Jira issues sharing the same local_id property. Sort each set by Jira created_at timestamp (older=keeper at index 0, newer=closees). No CLI changes.

## TDD Test Spec
Given a Jira fixture with two issues sharing the same local_id but different created_at; When enumerate_duplicate_anomalies() is invoked; Then the returned dict key 'duplicates' contains exactly one set with the older issue at index 0 (keeper).

## testing_mode: RED
data.title: Add enumerate_duplicate_anomalies() importable function to ticket-bridge-fsck.py
